items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: And we were playing opposite Charlie Gaines' band in Philadelphia with the band that Louis Jordan was in.

ctx.x: And we were playing opposite Charlie Gaines' band in Philadelphia with the band that Louis Jordan was in. So the bass player's name was Mr. Hayes. I never remembered his first name, but I always remember he was Mr. Hayes. So he was like about 37, and I'm 17, you know, smart, you know.
